commit 0a3bef53c8e5fff4b5c199b18fa0c52e0e08b037
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Jun 11 17:28:39 2026 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Thu Jun 11 17:28:39 2026 +1200

    Bug 2046682 - Port bug 2046273: replace resolve_keyed_by with task-context where possible/sensible. rs=bustage-fix DONTBUILD
    Port of https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/26effd08df388a68ef331af2687b8b6a2ee5c74e
    and https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/d28acd93606d1098e5daf64885fc7a9af0a8a23d.

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/__init__.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/__init__.py
index d7f6a84a320..0ac701b06bc 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/__init__.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/__init__.py
@@ -43,6 +43,7 @@ def register(graph_config):
     the process.
     """
     extend_sys_path(GECKO)
+    from gecko_taskgraph import task_context  # noqa - trigger custom task-context registration
     from gecko_taskgraph.util import dependencies  # noqa: F401 trigger group_by registration
 
     from comm_taskgraph.parameters import register_parameters
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/balrog/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/balrog/kind.yml
index d264b9180b0..ae9dba69a03 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/balrog/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/balrog/kind.yml
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@ loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
 transforms:
     - taskgraph.transforms.from_deps
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.name_sanity
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.balrog_submit
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.scriptworker:add_balrog_scopes
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task
@@ -17,6 +18,15 @@ kind-dependencies:
 only-for-attributes:
     - shippable
 
+task-defaults:
+    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
+    task-context:
+        from-parameters:
+            project: project
+            release-type: release_type
+        substitution-fields:
+            - update-no-wnp
+
 tasks:
     balrog:
         from-deps:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/bouncer-locations/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/bouncer-locations/kind.yml
index df48ca7d6d2..88c7f87d997 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/bouncer-locations/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/bouncer-locations/kind.yml
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@ kind-dependencies:
     - post-beetmover-dummy
 
 transforms:
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.bouncer_locations:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release:run_on_releases
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
@@ -16,6 +17,11 @@ transforms:
 task-defaults:
     run-on-repo-type: [hg]
     description: nightly bouncer locations job
+    task-context:
+        from-custom:
+            - release-level
+        substitution-fields:
+            - scopes
     attributes:
         shippable: true
     worker-type: bouncer
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml
index 09f27798c2d..f320844b4a6 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
 loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
 
 transforms:
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.bouncer_aliases:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
@@ -15,6 +16,15 @@ kind-dependencies:
 task-defaults:
     run-on-repo-type: [hg]
     description: Update bouncer aliases job
+    task-context:
+        from-parameters:
+            release-type: release_type
+        from-custom:
+            - release-level
+        substitution-fields:
+            - worker-type
+            - scopes
+            - bouncer-products-per-alias
     worker-type: bouncer
     worker:
         implementation: bouncer-aliases
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-sub/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-sub/kind.yml
index b39570fa623..90791d4ad94 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-sub/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-sub/kind.yml
@@ -5,6 +5,8 @@
 loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
 
 transforms:
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release:run_on_releases
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - comm_taskgraph.transforms.l10n:handle_keyed_by_local
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.bouncer_submission:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
@@ -12,6 +14,15 @@ transforms:
 task-defaults:
     run-on-repo-type: [hg]
     description: release bouncer submission job
+    task-context:
+        from-parameters:
+            release-type: release_type
+        from-custom:
+            - release-level
+        substitution-fields:
+            - worker-type
+            - scopes
+            - bouncer-products
     worker-type: bouncer
     worker:
         implementation: bouncer-submission
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-mark-as-shipped/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-mark-as-shipped/kind.yml
index d22d85495e0..46a077a00c8 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-mark-as-shipped/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-mark-as-shipped/kind.yml
@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@ loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
 
 transforms:
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_mark_as_shipped:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
 
@@ -17,6 +18,12 @@ kind-dependencies:
 task-defaults:
     run-on-repo-type: [hg]
     description: mark release as shipped in Ship-It
+    task-context:
+        from-custom:
+            - release-level
+        substitution-fields:
+            - worker-type
+            - scopes
     worker-type: shipit
     worker:
         implementation: shipit-shipped
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-update-product-channel-version/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-update-product-channel-version/kind.yml
index ec245d39c62..bbfff2b654a 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-update-product-channel-version/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-update-product-channel-version/kind.yml
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@ kind-dependencies:
     - post-beetmover-dummy
 
 transforms:
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_update_product_channel_version:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release:run_on_releases
@@ -16,6 +17,11 @@ transforms:
 task-defaults:
     run-on-repo-type: [hg]
     description: Update product channel version in Ship-It
+    task-context:
+        from-custom:
+            - release-level
+        substitution-fields:
+            - scopes
     attributes:
         shippable: true
     worker-type: shipit
